verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine and apps, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Local serving on 127.0.0.1 and on-device apps describe where inference runs, not a documented telemetry control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
